description: Catalog of MCP servers vetted for k8s-pilot. The active set is declared in .vscode/mcp.json; this catalog documents alternatives operators can switch in.

servers.title: Kubernetes MCP server (manusa)
servers.description: Exposes kubectl-equivalent read operations (get, describe, logs, events) plus apiserver discovery. Suitable for the read/discovery path; mutations still go through the scripts/<tool>/ wrappers per CLAUDE.md R1.
safetyNotes: Read-only by intent for this repo's workflow. Do NOT use any MCP tool that performs writes; rely on scripts/<tool>/Invoke-*.ps1 wrappers for all mutations.
The server inherits your active kubeconfig. Confirm the intended context with `kubectl config current-context` before driving queries.
If a tool exposed by the server appears to take action (apply/delete/patch), refuse and ask the user — the harness contract is wrapper-mediated mutations only (CLAUDE.md R1).
